intro: At Sentinel Hill, Osric's Crate brings armor from Stormwind to the People's Militia. The defenders face the Defias Brotherhood and marauding gnolls without the Stormwind army.

p: Westfall faces the Defias Brotherhood and marauding gnolls, while the Stormwind army remains absent. At Sentinel Hill, the People's Militia must make do without the crown's formal support. Osric's Crate holds freshly made armor from the capital, sent to Quartermaster Lewis to distribute among the volunteer fighters.

Gryphons carry the crate from Dungar Longdrink's roost in Stormwind's Trade District to Thor at Sentinel Hill. The flight avoids the dangerous roads through Elwynn Forest and across the Westfall border, where bandits may ambush travelers. Gryphons help keep frontier garrisons supplied during wartime.
